source_name: FCC Farmland Values Report — Alberta cultivated farmland annual % change
note: Provincial averages for cultivated farmland. Used only to trend-adjust older aggregate base values; raw base values are always retained. Not a parcel appraisal.

regional_notes.northern: Often tracks near provincial average; northern AB reported strong gains in recent years.
regional_notes.southern: Irrigated pockets can exceed dryland % moves — FCC region tables refine this when available.
